combo1.title: Going First: Zenet Revelator Nefertari Alone
combo1.description: Going first from one card: Zenet Revelator Nefertari. Its on-summon effect sends Nefertari to the GY, shows Tri-Horned Dragon and Blue-Eyes White Dragon from the Deck, and Sets Pere-Zenet Em Heru and Zenet Per Aarkh. Per Aarkh adds Zenet-Nakhte Sphinx. Sphinx discards itself for Return Journey to the Light "Zenet", and because Per Aarkh was already in the GY, that discard lets Per Aarkh banish itself to Special Summon Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon, treated as a Normal Monster Card. Em Heru draws a card for that summon, then Ritual Summons Sphinx back from the GY with Tri-Horned Dragon and Blue-Eyes White Dragon from the Deck and equips Tri-Horned Dragon to it. Return Journey shows three Normal Monster Cards to Special Summon Zenet Revelator Amenhotep from the Deck, and Amenhotep Sets Zenet Cataract and Zenet Thunder Fall. End board: Zenet-Nakhte Sphinx (5000 ATK, unaffected by your opponent's activated effects while equipped), Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon (4500), Pere-Zenet Em Heru, a Set Zenet Cataract and Zenet Thunder Fall, and one drawn card. Your Normal Summon is spent on Nefertari. Ash Blossom can stop Per Aarkh's search, Sphinx's search, Em Heru's Ritual Summon (it sends cards from the Deck) or Return Journey's summon from the Deck; it can't touch Nefertari's or Amenhotep's Sets.

combo2.title: Going First: Zenet-Nakhte Sphinx Alone, through Tau-Zenet Adjat and Black Skull Dragon
combo2.description: Going first from one card: Zenet-Nakhte Sphinx. Sphinx discards itself for Return Journey to the Light "Zenet", which shows three Normal Monster Cards from the Deck (Tri-Horned Dragon, Blue-Eyes White Dragon and Labradorite Dragon) to Special Summon Zenet Revelator Nefertari. Nefertari Sets Pere-Zenet Em Heru and Zenet Per Aarkh. Per Aarkh adds Tau-Zenet Adjat, and Adjat discards itself to send Zenet Thunder Fall from the Deck to the GY. That discard lets Per Aarkh call Black Skull Dragon, whose 3200 ATK matches Adjat's. Em Heru draws, then Ritual Summons Sphinx from the GY with Tri-Horned Dragon and Blue-Eyes White Dragon and equips Blue-Eyes White Dragon. Black Skull Dragon alone puts your Normal Monster Cards over 3000 ATK, so Thunder Fall banishes itself from the GY to Set Amduat Zenet. End board: Zenet-Nakhte Sphinx (equipped), Black Skull Dragon, Pere-Zenet Em Heru, a Set Amduat Zenet and one drawn card, with your Normal Summon still unused. By card text, Amduat Zenet can then Ritual Summon Tau-Zenet Adjat from the GY on your opponent's turn by sending Black Skull Dragon (Level 9) and equip Tri-Horned Dragon to it; that follow-up isn't part of the simulated line.

combo4.title: Going Second: Nefertari + Tau-Zenet Adjat Clear Two Monsters
combo4.description: Going second into two monsters, from Zenet Revelator Nefertari and Tau-Zenet Adjat. Nefertari Sets Pere-Zenet Em Heru and Zenet Per Aarkh, Per Aarkh adds Zenet-Nakhte Sphinx, and Sphinx discards itself for Return Journey to the Light "Zenet". The discard calls Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon through Per Aarkh, and Em Heru draws. Em Heru then Ritual Summons Adjat from your hand with Tri-Horned Dragon from the Deck (Level 8 covers Level 8) and equips Tri-Horned Dragon. Adjat's Quick Effect sends Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon and the equipped Tri-Horned Dragon to the GY to return both opposing monsters to the hand, then Special Summons Tri-Horned Dragon from the GY. Return Journey shows two Normal Monster Cards to Special Summon Twin-Headed Thunder Dragon from the Extra Deck. That leaves Tau-Zenet Adjat (3200), Tri-Horned Dragon (2850) and Twin-Headed Thunder Dragon (2800) facing an empty field: 8850 damage if nothing stops the attacks. Per Aarkh's no-direct-attack clause only covered Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon, and Return Journey's summon carries none. The simulator stops at the end of the Main Phase; the attacks aren't simulated.
